name: site-shot/website-screenshots
description: Website screenshots for AI agents with Site-Shot: a real Chromium browser, full-page capture, and renders from a chosen country. Bundles the website-screenshots skill and the published site-shot-mcp server. Needs SITESHOT_API_KEY in the agent's environment; under Codex, replace the installed server's env table with env_vars = ["SITESHOT_API_KEY"].
